license_note: Meta publishes the weights, tokenizer, and original checkpoints under the custom Llama 3.1 Community License, which carries attribution and redistribution duties, a "Built with Llama" display requirement, a 700 million monthly-active-user commercial threshold, and an incorporated acceptable-use policy, making the release source-available rather than open source.

license_evidence.scope: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct weights, tokenizer, original checkpoints, and related Llama materials
Acceptable-use policy incorporated by reference into the Llama Community License

access_boundary: This record represents the meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct release. The base model it was derived from, sibling sizes, quantizations, fine-tunes, Meta-hosted products, and independent serving providers are separate model or service boundaries. The 3.1 base model, the 70B and 405B siblings, Llama Guard 3, and Prompt Guard remain separate records.
strengths: Meta publishes both Transformers-compatible Safetensors shards and original consolidated checkpoints with a checklist file
The model card names the governing license, the base model, a release date, and a static-model status statement
tradeoffs: Artifact access is gated behind a contact-information agreement and the custom license carries attribution, scale, and acceptable-use restrictions
The model card documents no hosted serving paths, so independent availability must be verified with each operator
